meta.component: BookingForm (used in BookingPanel Sheet and inline in #book section)
meta.model: Instant-confirm booking request. No external calendar. n8n checks the slot against Notion and confirms or rejects. Phase 2 (later episodes) adds reminder and review-request workflows on top of the same Notion database.

business_rules.timezone: America/Phoenix (Arizona does not observe DST — all times shown and stored in this zone)
business_rules.bookable_window: from tomorrow up to 60 days ahead
business_rules.capacity: 1 booking per slot (demo). Slot uniqueness key = `${date}T${time}` e.g. 2026-10-21T10:30
business_rules.treatments_source: src/lib/treatments.ts (same 6 as site spec) + extra option { id: 'consultation', name: 'Consultation — not sure yet', duration: '30 min' }

header.title: Reserve your visit
header.text: Takes under a minute. You'll receive a confirmation by email right away.

ui.steps_note: Single scrolling form inside the panel, visually grouped into three blocks with small gold numerals: 01 Treatment · 02 Date & time · 03 Your details. Not a multi-page wizard.

fields.name: treatmentId
fields.label: Treatment
fields.default: preselected when opened from a treatment row, else empty

fields.name: date
fields.label: Preferred date
fields.control: Calendar in Popover (shadcn). Disable past days, today, Sundays and dates > 60 days ahead. Display format 'Tue, Oct 21'.

fields.name: time
fields.label: Preferred time
fields.control: Grid of time chips (radio group), 3 columns on mobile / 4 on desktop. Disabled until a date is chosen.

fields.name: firstVisit
fields.label: This is my first visit to Velure

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I agree to be contacted by email about this appointment. Velure is a demo project by Thaus.

fields.name: company
fields.control: Honeypot: visually hidden input, tabIndex -1, autocomplete off, aria-hidden. Must stay empty.

ui.summary_bar: Sticky bottom bar inside the panel showing the live selection: '<Treatment> · Tue, Oct 21 · 10:30 AM' + submit button.

states.loading: button shows spinner + loading label, all fields disabled
states.success: Form content cross-fades to a confirmation view: gold check line-drawing (SVG stroke-dashoffset), title 'You're booked.', text 'We've sent a confirmation to {email}. See you on {date} at {time}.', buttons 'Add another booking' (reset) and 'Close'.
states.slot_taken: HTTP 409 → inline message above time grid: 'That time was just taken — please choose another.' Disable that chip locally and keep all other values.
states.validation_error: HTTP 400 → map returned `errors` to fields; otherwise generic message.
states.network_error: 'We couldn't reach our booking system. Please try again, or call (480) 555-0142.' Keep form values.

validation_schema_zod.date: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/) + refine: not Sunday, between tomorrow and +60 days (Phoenix time)
validation_schema_zod.consent: z.literal(true, { errorMap: () => ({ message: 'Please confirm to continue' }) })

responses.honeypot_filled: n8n returns 200 { ok: true } silently and stores nothing (do not tip off bots)

client_implementation_notes: Submit helper in src/lib/submit.ts: postJSON(urlEnv, body, { timeoutMs }) using fetch + AbortController; returns { status, data }.
Never trust the client: n8n re-validates everything (see n8n/velure_booking_workflow.json).
When the panel opens with a treatment preselected, focus the date trigger; otherwise focus the treatment select.
Persist an unsent draft in sessionStorage (wrapped in try/catch) so closing the panel by accident does not lose input; clear on success.
Track a lightweight analytics event (Vercel Analytics custom event 'booking_submitted') on success only.

phase_2_hooks.reminder_workflow: Schedule (hourly) → Notion query: Status=Confirmed, Reminder sent=false, Appointment within next 24h → email reminder → set Reminder sent=true.
phase_2_hooks.review_workflow: Schedule (daily 19:30 Phoenix) → Notion query: Status=Completed, Review requested=false → review-request email → set Review requested=true.
phase_2_hooks.note: Planned for content episodes EP 14 and EP 15. Not part of the first build.
